stage: Prospective engineering historical-test-reuse/development-transfer protocol before any new POD historical-role outcomes
freshness: HISTORICAL TEST REUSE: old FNO results and source-data roles were previously inspected. This is development transfer, not pristine confirmation, independent test discovery, student preregistration or a new benchmark split.
pre_outcome_access: Protocol compiled from cached dataset/split manifests and metadata CSVs only. Array hashes were taken from the existing dataset manifest; no historical test arrays or new model outcomes were opened to choose this protocol.
cohort_correction: The original parent task assumed two OOD slices. Existing manifests show four for penobscot_000; root approved retaining ALL FOUR before new outcomes. Fixed totals are16ID+4OOD=20 slices,8ID+1OOD parents.

preprocessing.evaluation_model: Convert cached positive physical squared slowness to velocity, Gaussian smooth velocity, convert back to squared slowness
preprocessing.observations: Cached float32 regenerated synthetic true wavefields restricted to the original receiver indices. No new measured field data; no regeneration or outcome-dependent preprocessing.

staging.new_historical_freeze: A fresh clean Python subprocess audits all preceding source/runtime/weight freeze guards without importing the new historical module. Then this explicit prospective phase admits only its allowlisted new imported files, records all added unrelated/unimported paths, and freezes the complete current manifest/runtime plus prior receipt and weight snapshots. Existing stage guards and previous artifacts are unchanged.
staging.evaluation_gate: No historical test-array loading or project outcomes until root approves this protocol/source and a new immutable historical freeze exists. Every previously frozen source path and numerical runtime must remain unchanged.

reporting.primary: Actual shared24-block aggregate objective/gradient cosine, norms and true descent per slice for all five fixed models. No average-block-cosine substitute.
reporting.corrected_certificate: At one common normalized negative summed physical-gradient direction, save all24 block diagnostics and sum signed physical derivatives/bounds. Report aggregate availability, strict certification, false acceptance, bound coverage and exact-fallback requirement. No AD-of-composite-state-objective claim.
reporting.unavailable: Retain all finite raw/partially corrected proposals and quality outcomes, null unavailable bounds/uppers and explicit exact-fallback-required. No online exact fallback. Numeric aggregate overflow/nonfinite proposals retain raw diagnostics and make the attempt incomplete; never silently discard a case into a complete comparison.
reporting.clustering: Within each role, first average each parent across all its slices; report8 ID-parent summaries and1 OOD-parent summary separately. Do not pool20 slices or480 blocks as independent samples.
reporting.uncertainty: Descriptive fixed historical cohort only: no IID confidence intervals, binomial coverage claims, conformal nominal guarantee, new-population generalization or ID/OOD pooling.
reporting.statistical_gates: No new statistical gates or scale fitting in this phase. The old calibration receipts bind model identity only; no FNO scale is transferred to POD.
reporting.cost: Record all current exact-reference verification work, neural single-block/shared-batch calls, POD operator projections/reduced work, coarse setup/correction/operator/norm work, per-case and cumulative counters. Historical observation generation, training, SVD and calibration remain referenced paid offline work, not newly measured free compute. No inversion or speedup claim.
reporting.all_outcomes: All20 slices and all5 models are mandatory for completion:100 slice-model aggregates,2400 block-model rows,45 parent-model summaries. Retain failures/abstentions and original artifacts.

limits: Previously inspected historical source roles, not pristine confirmation
One OOD parent cannot establish broad OOD reliability
Parent isolation is audited but no independent geological sampling assumption is asserted
Ordinary floating-point discrete certificate implementation, not a formally verified roundoff enclosure
No optimizer, inversion trajectory, runtime acceleration or field-scale claim
